            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after

            lower-cased.

          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          description: >-

            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table

            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.

          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4

            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date

            existing owner has the same lastName and address (compared

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if an
            existing owner has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the
                first eight upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalised telephone concatenated with its
                lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the owner's customerCode, processed
                right-to-left with every second digit doubled.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Set
                when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an
                existing owner has the same lastName and address; both owners
                are then assigned this identifier.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d-372b-3f4a-8b4a-1d2c3e4f5a6b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation: starting at 1, add 1 when an email is present and add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for
                tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, read from the '<REGION>' component
                of its region-and-hash customerCode (the region derived from the
                owner's postcode, falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration date; 'true'
                once that threshold is exceeded, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. A
                create request is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new
                owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same
                household (same householdId) with different telephones have
                different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string

          readOnly: true

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the read-only 'ageBand', the owner's age band computed
            against the registrationDate. Stored and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if an
            existing owner has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the
                first eight upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalised telephone concatenated with its
                lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the owner's customerCode, processed
                right-to-left with every second digit doubled.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. Set
                when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an
                existing owner has the same lastName and address; both owners
                are then assigned this identifier.
              type: string
              example: '9e107d9d-372b-3f4a-8b4a-1d2c3e4f5a6b'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Counts only owners created before this one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where <customerCode> is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation: starting at 1, add 1 when an email is present and add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for
                tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, read from the '<REGION>' component
                of its region-and-hash customerCode (the region derived from the
                owner's postcode, falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created for the same registration date; 'true'
                once that threshold is exceeded, otherwise 'false'.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. A
                create request is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a new
                owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because
                the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same
                household (same householdId) with different telephones have
                different identity keys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. Stored and returned in E.164 form (e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed city-to-region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. An out-of-range postcode is
            rejected with 400. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it is used to
            derive the read-only 'ageBand', the owner's age band computed
            against the registrationDate. Stored and returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if an
            existing owner has the same lastName and address (compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the canonical region derived from the owner's postcode
                (falling back to its city, otherwise 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the
                first eight upper-case hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalised telephone concatenated with its
                lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-9F86D081'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit

I implemented the `ageBand` derivation for owners. When a create request includes `birthDate` (ISO), the owner's age band is returned on read, computed against `registrationDate`.

2. **`model/OwnerDerivations.java`** — added a pure `ageBand(birthDate, registrationDate)`: whole-years age via `Period.between`, `MINOR` (<18), `ADULT` (18–64), `SENIOR` (65+), and `null` when either date is absent. Follows the existing derivation pattern.
